resources.string: Stay on track with gentle reminders
EduAI can send helpful updates about your streak, study reminders, and learning progress — only when something is worth your attention.\n\nYou can change or turn these off anytime in Settings.

Notifications are currently turned off for EduAI. To see streak reminders, study alerts, and progress updates, enable them in your device Settings.\n\nTap below and switch Notifications on for this app.
We never send ads or spam — just the updates you opt into.
